request.spec:
The sheet has a policy date (settings, SETTING_CHANGED key=policy-date value=<date>); when it is
blank the policy date is the sheet's today. A claim dated before the policy date rounds half up;
a claim dated on or after it rounds half to even. This decides every rounding of that claim's live
figures (the rate step and the late charge). A correction rounds by the date of the claim it
corrects, not its own. Settled figures stay frozen and figures bound by a statement stay bound.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The sheet has a policy date (settings, SETTING_CHANGED key=policy-date value=<date>); when it is
blank the policy date is the sheet's today. A claim dated before the policy date rounds half up;
a claim dated on or after it rounds half to even. This decides every rounding of that claim's live
figures (the rate step and the late charge). A correction rounds by the date of the claim it

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The sheet now has a policy date setting, and each claim's rounding follows it. A claim dated before the policy date rounds half up; one dated on or after it rounds half to even. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 acceptance tests.

**Stored data and settings**
- New migration `V24__policy_date.sql` adds a `policy_date` column to the sheet's settings. Empty means "use the sheet's today".
- The settings save accepts a date or a blank. It writes the audit line `SETTING_CHANGED sheet=… by=… key=policy-date value=<date>`, with an empty value when the date is cleared.

**Rounding (`claim/Figures.java`)**
- One rule picks half up or half to even for each claim, and it now drives both the rate step and the late charge. Before this, both always rounded half to even.
- A correction rounds by the date of the claim it corrects. If that claim can't be found, it falls back to its own date.
- Settled figures and figures bound by a statement don't change. Only live figures use the new rule.

**Front end**
- Every claim the server sends now carries a `halfUp` flag. The front end's own due and late-charge sums use it, so the screen rounds the same way as the server.
- The settings panel has a new policy-date field with the test ids `setting-policy-date` and `setting-policy-date-current`. A badly formed date shows the existing `settings-error`.
- Saving settings now reloads the claims, because the policy date can change how they round. Changing the sheet's today also reloads them, because a blank policy date means today.

The reload on a today change isn't something the tests check. I added it because without it the `halfUp` flags would be out of date until the sheet was reloaded.
